nativeMounts.frameContract: Use actual body sprite clip/frame and PPU. localXY=(sourceXY*pixelScale+originXY)/spritePPU; mirror local X then body transform. originXY retains the existing approved foot-origin correction. BoneFollower followLocalScale rotation includes 180 degrees for negative local scaleX. No independent clock; no capture/PPU edit.
